description: AI Automation Scheduler - Create, manage, and execute scheduled tasks with thread/agent linking. Supports cron expressions, datetime triggers, webhooks, and conditional execution. AI agents can create automations for users.

tools.name: scheduler_create_task
tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:
(1) ALWAYS execute THIS tool NOW - NEVER reference 'I created earlier' or use conversation history
(2) MUST return format: **[Name]** | ID: `[id]` | URL: [full_url] | Link: [title](url)
(3) Use EXACT values from tool response - NEVER make up fake URLs/IDs
(4) If tool fails, say 'Failed to create' - NEVER pretend it succeeded

Example response:
Created: **New Document**
- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

Create a scheduled automation task. Links to threads, agents, and Synergy sessions. Supports recurring (cron) and one-time (datetime) schedules. Use when user asks to 'schedule', 'automate', 'remind me', 'send daily/weekly', etc. Returns task_id for management.

task_name.description: Clear, descriptive task name (REQUIRED). Example: 'Daily Sales Report Email'

description.description: What this task does and why. Example: 'Send daily analytics report to management team'

cron_expression.description: Cron expression for recurring tasks. Examples: '0 9 * * 1-5' (Mon-Fri 9am), '0 * * * *' (hourly), '0 0 * * 0' (Sunday midnight). Required if trigger_type='cron'.

datetime_trigger.description: ISO datetime for one-time execution. Example: '2025-11-16T14:00:00Z'. Required if trigger_type='datetime'.

action_type.description: What to do: 'resume_session' (resume Synergy), 'send_message' (chat with agent), 'execute_tool' (run specific tool), 'run_workflow' (multi-step automation)

synergy_session_id.description: Link to Synergy session (if action_type='resume_session'). Example: 'sess_12345678'

thread_id.description: Conversation thread to use. Links task to specific chat context.

agent_name.description: Which AI agent executes this task. Examples: 'Prime Agent', 'Email Agent', 'Research Agent', 'Marketing Agent'

location.description: Where task runs in UI. Examples: 'dashboard', 'synergy_sidebar', 'agent_panel'

action_payload.description: Action-specific configuration. For 'send_message': {message: 'text'}. For 'execute_tool': {tool_name: 'x', tool_params: {}}. For 'run_workflow': {steps: [...]}

context_instructions.description: Additional instructions for AI when executing. Example: 'Include last 7 days of data. Use professional tone.'

requires_approval.description: If true, user must approve before task runs. Default: false. Use for sensitive operations (emails, payments, deletions).

enabled.description: If false, task is disabled and won't run. Default: true.

timeout_seconds.description: Max execution time in seconds. Default: 300 (5 minutes).

max_retries.description: Max retry attempts on failure. Default: 3.

retry_delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retry. Default: 300 (5 minutes).

returns.description: Created task with task_id, full task object, and success message

examples.description: Daily report email every weekday at 9am
